lines: Not time-difference-born knowledge-difference arises; from object-difference not knowledge different like mountain-circle.
l4.sanskrit_cite: na kālabhedajanito jñānabhedaḥ prakalpate saṃvedyabhedānna jñānaṃ bhinnaṃ śikharivṛttavat
